caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cross with a carved, rustic appearance, inserted at an angle into a rounded wooden base that is partially surrounded by clusters of green grass blades. The wood color is light brown with visible texture details. Draped over the arms of the cross is a vine featuring orange trumpet-shaped flowers with yellow highlights and green stems and leaves. The background is plain, off-white, with no additional objects or scenery, and there is a handwritten inscription in the bottom right corner that reads “MAJEL B. CLAFLIN. TAOS. N.M.”
title: Wooden Cross used as Headstone
